hero.beat: I build the part of the web people actually touch.

about.label: About me
body: I’m a frontend developer at InspireIT, and I live in Ankara. Before that I spent over a year at GuruDesk, and I got my start in 2019 as an intern at Bilgeweb.

My favourite moment in the work is when a design stops being a picture and starts working in the browser. Most days that means React, Vue or Astro: new pages, fixes to products that already exist, and finding out why something is slow.
I spend a lot of time on small things. How a button answers a tap, how a page behaves on a phone, where an animation comes to rest.

items.name: Porch
items.stack: Next.js 16 · Supabase · Stripe · shadcn/ui · Cloudflare Workers
items.summary: A link-in-bio page builder: sign up, add a photo, links and a theme, and share one short address. The editor shows every change on a phone preview as you type.
items.detail: Built from idea to working product with Next.js, Supabase and Stripe on Cloudflare Workers. Plan limits live in the database, only Stripe webhooks can change a plan, and public pages score 98 on mobile Lighthouse.
items.alt: The Porch home page: the headline “One link for everything you make” beside three phones showing link-in-bio pages.
items.altMobile: A Porch public page on a phone: a potter’s profile with a featured link and four more.

items.name: Parley
items.summary: An AI chat that answers with more than text. Ask for the weather and a forecast card appears; ask for a sum and you get the exact number. Replies show up as they are being written.
items.detail: Built with Nuxt 4 and Nuxt UI, it runs entirely on Cloudflare’s free tier. Turnstile, signed sessions and rate limits keep bots away from the AI quota.
items.stack: Nuxt 4 · Nuxt UI · AI SDK · Workers AI · TypeScript
items.alt: Parley answering a question about the weather in Istanbul with a forecast card and a calculation card.
items.altMobile: Parley on a phone, showing the local time in Tokyo.

items.alt: The InspireIT home page: a headline about digital transformation next to a grid of four diamond-shaped images.
